No `curl`, `wget`, `base64`, or other network/download commands appear at the top level. The `prepare()`, `build()`, and `package()` functions are defined but not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. The `_google_api_key` variable is merely assigned, not transmitted anywhere. Nothing at the global scope downloads code, exfiltrates data, or executes untrusted payloads.
</details>
